review_scope: Three safe receipts only; metadata and arithmetic review, no private witness or A/B/C recheck.

conclusion.meaning: The original independent observer's A/B/C observations may support considering conditional-equivalence research, with the receipt defects and timing provenance disclosed. This is not a new semantic verification.

checks.input_identity_scope: Compared receipt metadata only; no original input rehash.

timing_assessment.reasoning: A sample inside a completed call plus that entire call duration is a conservative upper bound, conditional on authentic, compatible timing metadata and no later semantic work.
timing_assessment.provenance: Original reviewer transcribed tool-return excerpts. Neither root nor this reviewer inspected raw tool logs. Only the addition and comparisons were independently recomputed here.
timing_assessment.field_defects: semantic_elapsed_seconds incorrectly records receipt time; completed_within_original_deadline conflates two gates. Its false value does not prove a 180-second overrun. Missing completion_passed remains missing.
timing_assessment.code_defect_scope: The stated variable overwrite is plausible and consistent with the receipts, but its source-code cause was not independently inspected.

output_accounting.interpretation: Original reviewer result count may remain one. Later clarification and this review are additional disclosed outputs in separate correction work, not retrospectively zero-cost original outputs. Do not claim the whole directory or complete workflow produced one file.

not_established: Unqualified compliance of the original narrow receipt: its schema/phase-timing defects and inconclusive status remain.
Exact semantic or display end time, raw-log-authenticated timing, independently verified natural exit, or absence of later semantic work.
New A/B/C correctness, original-data reproduction, official legality or execution, independent holdout, population frequency, or benefit.
Old V2 strict acceptance, model admission, or authorization to relabel, train, expand matches or run PPO.
interpretation_boundary: Arithmetic supports the reported timing explanation; it does not repair the original bytes or silently create completion_passed=true. Root may credit the limited semantic evidence while keeping formal receipt defects explicit.

timing.write_end_record: Exact post-flush write_ended_utc and elapsed are emitted in this tool return; they never replace review_ended_utc.
